I just wrote an article [How AI Experts Can Drive Better Collaboration in Drug
Discovery](https://valencelabs.substack.com/p/how-ai-experts-can-drive-better-collaboration)
on Valence's substack, reflecting on some experiences I've had at
Valence/Recursion. Please read it on substack!

Essentially I argue that, on the margin, AI experts should be more assertive
when formulating the problem, since domain experts don't always get it right.
Even though they know the _problem_ well, formalization itself is a skill, and
AI experts are probably better on average.
